latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Xiaohongshu MCP skill.

- Automates Xiaohongshu (RedNote) content operations using a Python client for the xiaohongshu-mcp server.
- Supports publishing image, text, and video content; searching for notes and trends; analyzing post details and comments; and managing user profiles and feeds.
- Requires a local xiaohongshu-mcp server setup with platform-specific binaries and QR code login.
- Includes a Python script with commands for status checking, search, feed retrieval, post publishing, and note detail analysis.
- Designed for social media management, research, and automation on Xiaohongshu.
